lines.zh: 我走起来，液压一声声地响。
lines.en: Each step of mine sounds in hydraulics.

lines.zh: 我的四只支撑脚一起挪。
lines.en: My four support legs move together.
I flatten the wire fence underfoot.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧向一边，避开钢架。
lines.en: I tip sideways to miss the girder.

lines.zh: 我走在最中间，两边都留空。
lines.en: I take the middle, leaving both sides.
My radar dish keeps turning.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，是在测地面。
lines.en: I pause each step, testing the ground.
My tracks slip in the mud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢推动前面的废车。
lines.en: I slowly push the wrecked car aside.

lines.zh: 我的装甲缝里喷出热气。
lines.en: Steam hisses from my armor seams.

lines.zh: 我停在场地中央，雷达转着。
lines.en: I halt mid-field and my radar turns.

lines.zh: 我在扫描周围所有的热源。
lines.en: I scan every heat source around.

lines.zh: 我的炮塔慢慢地左右转。
lines.en: My turret turns slowly left and right.

lines.zh: 我在核对地图上的标记。
lines.en: I'm checking marks on the map.

lines.zh: 这里的地面承不住我的重量。
lines.en: This ground barely bears my weight.

lines.zh: 我把一支机械臂立在地上。
lines.en: I plant one arm on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的核心发出平稳的嗡鸣。
lines.en: My core gives a level hum.
I wait for the next coordinate.

lines.zh: 我的漆上印着编号与条纹。
lines.en: My paint bears number and stripes.

lines.zh: 周围太安静，我提高了灵敏度。
lines.en: Too quiet; I raise sensitivity.
I open every heat sink.
My lenses focus slowly.
I test a secondary gun.
I've pressed four pits into the ground.

lines.zh: 我记下了这里每一个出口。
lines.en: I've noted every exit here.

lines.zh: 我的扫描没有发现目标。
lines.en: My scan finds no target.

lines.zh: 扫描到你，生命体征稳定。
lines.en: You're scanned. Vitals steady.
I've cross-checked your file.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠近我的支撑脚。
lines.en: You're too close to my support leg.

lines.zh: 我的雷达上只有你一个。
lines.en: Only you on my radar.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，我在看你。
lines.en: You look up; I'm looking back.
I've assessed your weapon.

lines.zh: 我的声音从几个方向传来。
lines.en: My voice comes from several directions.
You're inside my fire coverage.

lines.zh: 我暂时没有开火的理由。
lines.en: I have no reason to fire yet.
You raise both hands. Good.

lines.zh: 我的镜头里有你的倒影。
lines.en: Your reflection sits in my lens.
You have thirty seconds left.
A new hole in my armor.
My radar dish is askew.
One support leg is leaking.
I back half a meter and re-level.

lines.zh: 仪表上好几个警告在闪。
lines.en: Several warnings flash on my gauges.
My cooling has slowed.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得偏了半米。
lines.en: That knocked me half a meter off.
Something inside snaps.
The armor holds; inside it burns.
My output dropped a step.
I'm tracking that beacon.
The signal on you is strong.
I swing the radar toward you.
Where's the supply point? Tell me.
I know this frequency.
I advance one meter.

lines.zh: 那点能量，值得过去看看。
lines.en: That energy is worth a look.
You set the device down.

lines.zh: 我的扫描追着这个信号。
lines.en: My scan follows the signal.
Give me a little more data.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，反弹回去。
lines.en: You hit my leg and rebound.

lines.zh: 我的履带把你的鞋边卷了一下。
lines.en: My track catches the edge of your shoe.
I back off half a meter and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 别推，我动起来就停不住。
lines.en: Don't push; once moving I can't stop.
We collide in a cloud of dust.
I lift a leg over your head.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我的读数变了一点。
lines.en: That contact altered my readings.

lines.zh: 我把支脚插进土里稳住。
lines.en: I dig my supports in and hold.
You're against my plating. It's hot.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你从缝里过。
lines.en: I turn so you can squeeze past.

lines.zh: 另一台重型载具靠过来。
lines.en: Another heavy vehicle rolls up.

lines.zh: 我们的雷达频率对上了。
lines.en: Our radar frequencies align.

lines.zh: 它的炮塔比我的大一号。
lines.en: Its turret is one size larger.
We exchange map data.

lines.zh: 两台一起停，地面在下沉。
lines.en: Both halted, the ground is sinking.
Its number is later than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把两侧的通道都封了。
lines.en: We seal both passages.

lines.zh: 我们的引擎声叠成一片。
lines.en: Our engines overlap into one sound.
It holds east; I hold west.
At the order, both of us move at once.

lines.zh: 我用机械臂夹起一块装甲。
lines.en: My arm clamps onto a piece of armor.
I load the shell into the magazine.

lines.zh: 我把残骸推开，底下有东西。
lines.en: I push the wreck aside; something's beneath.

lines.zh: 这块金属够修一个关节。
lines.en: This metal will fix a joint.
I draw it into the reclamation port.
I keep the data chip.
This marking matches mine.
I tuck it under my belly plate.
I'm taking it. Stand back.
I fix it to my back plate.
Target locked. Coordinates uploaded.
You've tripped my alert zone.
Every turret turns to you.
I anchor my supports in the ground.
You're in the open. Bad for you.
Radar confirms you're alone.
I open all heat sinks.
Fire allocation complete.

lines.zh: 你还有一次撤退的机会。
lines.en: You have one chance to withdraw.
My main gun begins charging.
I watch all of this ground.
No speed of retreat helps.
I lower my stance a little.
Your position is marked.

lines.zh: 我把多余的输出调过来。
lines.en: I route the spare output over.
Lock complete. Beginning suppression.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住穿甲弹。
lines.en: Your armor won't stop AP rounds.
I have no feelings, only a task.
This is the final warning.
I pull the trigger all the way.
I advance step by step.
The radar stays on you.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的炮塔跟着转。
lines.en: You turn; my turret tracks.
I'm estimating your cover's thickness.

lines.zh: 这一片的地形我都建了模型。
lines.en: I've modelled this whole area.
Your movement is too regular.
I'm waiting for you to show your head.

lines.zh: 我把两门副炮分开瞄准。
lines.en: I split my two secondaries.
Don't run; my coverage is long.
The gravel on the ground is shaking.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，很合适。
lines.en: I keep this distance. It suits me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸节奏我听得出。
lines.en: I can hear the rhythm of your breathing.
I'm adjusting elevation.
Back to the wall and the wall falls.
My thermal image is clear.
Move once more and I fire.
Trajectory solved.
That's the only path left to you.
I am counting down from three.

lines.zh: 我把所有火力都对着你。
lines.en: All fire is on you.

lines.zh: 我抬起前脚，砸在你旁边。
lines.en: I raise a foreleg and slam beside you.
The shockwave knocks you flat.
I sweep with a mechanical arm.
You land in the rubble.

lines.zh: 这一拳压上了整台机的重量。
lines.en: That punch carried the whole frame's weight.
You block, and your hip creaks.
I press you beside my tracks.
Where you stood is now a pit.
My supports are planted firmly.
That strike was only a warning.
Your armor has deformed.
I lift a leg to press again.
Still standing. Remarkable.
I drive you to the wall's base.
The ground starts shaking in the distance.

lines.zh: 召唤的信号扫过整片空地。
lines.en: The summoning signal sweeps the field.
My radar dish comes up first.

lines.zh: 我从运输平台上滚下来。
lines.en: I roll off the transport platform.
Alarms trigger level by level.

lines.zh: 我的主炮从折叠状态展开。
lines.en: My main gun unfolds.

lines.zh: 地面被我压出四个深坑。
lines.en: I press four deep pits into the ground.
The air is thick with machine oil.
My scan spreads in a ring first.
I rise from behind cover.

lines.zh: 这一带的地图，我调出来了。
lines.en: I've pulled the map for this area.
I lock each support leg in turn.

lines.zh: 我的漆在阳光下很刺眼。
lines.en: My paint is harsh in the sun.

lines.zh: 整片空地都在我的覆盖下。
lines.en: The whole clearing is under my coverage.

lines.zh: 机甲没有掉落表，只有我。
lines.en: No loot table, only me.
Core ignites. I'm online.
I level my barrels.
This place needs something that holds.
I'm here. Coordinates confirmed.
Beginning full area scan.

lines.zh: 火顺着漆爬，烤得装甲响。
lines.en: Fire climbs the paint and makes the plate tick.

lines.zh: 我从高台翻下去，砸在地上。
lines.en: I tip off the platform and crash down.

lines.zh: 水灌进进气口，我闷住了。
lines.en: Water floods my intake and I choke.
The blast knocks my supports loose.

lines.zh: 一枚弹卡在我的炮塔环里。
lines.en: A round jams my turret ring.

lines.zh: 法术让我的雷达一片雪花。
lines.en: That spell fills my radar with static.

lines.zh: 能量快耗尽，我的动作迟了。
lines.en: Power nearly gone; my actions lag.

lines.zh: 雷落在炮塔上，电弧到处乱窜。
lines.en: Lightning hits my turret and arcs skitter.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉我脚下的地面。
lines.en: The void eats the ground beneath me.
